mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_view_history (user_id, place_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{placeId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, place_id) DO UPDATE SET viewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
SELECT h.place_id, p.name AS place_name, p.category, p.region, ( SELECT pi.image_url FROM place_images pi WHERE pi.place_id = h.place_id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order, pi.place_image_id LIMIT 1 ) AS primary_image_url, h.viewed_at FROM place_view_history h JOIN places p ON p.place_id = h.place_id
WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY h.viewed_at DESC, h.place_view_history_id DESC LIMIT #{size}
